operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are simple ASCII, no spaces/mixed case beyond Program_ID/Channel_ID/Share_in_percent/Rating_in_percent/Time_of_day/Date; still must double-quote.
DDL uses backtick-quoted FK refs (`channel`(`Channel_ID`)) inside CREATE TABLE; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
Tiny tables (5/10/11/9 rows) — no rowid sampling needed; original_values trivially complete.
broadcast and broadcast_share share identical PK (Channel_ID,Program_ID) and identical FK pair to channel/program; composite-PK members get max_l0=30.
broadcast_share.Date is TEXT storing 'DD,Month' (e.g. '01,May','04,April') — declared TEXT so TS dispatches to String, NOT Date; no date template will be inferred.
program.Launch is REAL but stores integer-valued years (2005.0, 2004.0) — Number fuzzer with scale from 'real' (no args) will produce floats far from year range.
Share_in_percent / Rating_in_percent are REAL percentages (0.3–5) but Number fuzzer range is [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from bare 'real' → huge implausible values.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE, no indexes, no views/triggers — insert failures only from PK duplicates.
FK parents (channel, program) are small and unique on PK; FK child columns in broadcast/broadcast_share have distinct < parent rows (Program_ID distinct 4 of 5).
Self-FK: none. Cycles: none. Table order: program, channel (level 0), broadcast, broadcast_share (level 1).
Column 'Date' name collides with the date-fuzzer keyword only via declared type, not name — safe.
Owner appears in both program and channel with different value sets (HBS vs CCTV etc.) — literal pool will merge via same-name anchor.
operator_ts_expectations: Program_ID / Channel_ID: Number fuzzer, int, scale from bare 'int' → range [-10,10] roughly, perturbed ±1/±2; PK uniqueness filter keeps ~5–10 distinct.
Name/Origin/Owner/Time_of_day: String fuzzer, length range from observed min/max, 50% contaminate → many garbage strings; literal pool from train SQL adds real names.
Launch: Number(real) → uniform floats in ~[-10,10] (scale from 'real' with no args), implausible as launch years → FN on year-range predicates.
Share_in_percent / Rating_in_percent: Number(real) → uniform in ~[-10,10], implausible as percentages (0–5) → FN on threshold predicates like Share_in_percent > 3.
broadcast_share.Date: String fuzzer → random 'a-zA-Z 0-9()' strings, NOT 'DD,Month' format → FN on any date-format predicate; literal pool may inject a few real '01,May' values.
broadcast/broadcast_share composite PK: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate (Channel_ID,Program_ID) pairs; with small parent sizes many rows dropped → small instances.
FK fill: broadcast.Channel_ID drawn from channel.Channel_ID final values (10), Program_ID from program.Program_ID (5) → broadcast rows ~min(10*5 combos, size).
broadcast_share.Program_ID distinct 4 < program 5 → some programs never broadcast; TS random fill will produce ties/duplicates the original lacks → FP on 'programs never broadcast' style queries.
Owner in channel has only 4 distinct of 10 rows (ties) — TS String fuzzer rarely reproduces ties → FP on GROUP BY Owner / COUNT DISTINCT Owner queries.
Time_of_day only 3 values (Morning/Noon/Night) — TS String fuzzer produces arbitrary strings → FN on Time_of_day='Morning' predicates unless literal pool supplies them.
No NULLs anywhere in original; TS Number/String fuzzers can emit None only via empty-element path (rare) → mostly non-null instances, matching original.
